name: Raven, Swarm of Ravens
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR -2, DEX +2, CON -1, INT -4, WIS +1, CHA -1. Perception 13. Stealth 12. Senses —. Languages —.
appearance: A flock of dark ravens with spread wings.

sections.Printed source: Cuervo, Enjambre de Cuervos, Cubil de Monstruos (Nosolorol, 2025), p. 341. Licensed Spanish translation of Kobold Press’s Monster Vault (2024). https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Carrion Sense. By scent, pinpoint carrion, dead creatures and Undead without Incorporeal Movement within 60 ft.
Pilfering Swarm. Ravens peck and pull at the clothing, hair, fur and belongings of creatures sharing the swarm’s space. A creature in that space casting a spell with a material component must pass a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, the ravens steal the component and the spell fails. The casting action is spent, and the spell slot or daily use is retained.
Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. The swarm fits through any opening large enough for a Tiny raven. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
Swarm Resilience. The swarm resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage and is immune to the charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained and stunned conditions.
sections.Actions: Beaks. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm’s space. A hit deals 9 (2d8) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) if the swarm has half its HP or less.

name: Rhinoceros
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Ability modifiers STR +5, DEX -1, CON +2, INT -4, WIS +1, CHA -2. Perception 11. Stealth 9. Senses —. Languages —.
appearance: A heavy gray rhinoceros with folded skin and two nose horns.

sections.Printed source: Rinoceronte, Cubil de Monstruos (Nosolorol, 2025), p. 354. Licensed Spanish translation of Kobold Press’s Monster Vault (2024). https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Resistances: Bludgeoning damage and the stunned condition. Halve incoming bludgeoning damage, rounded down. The rhinoceros has advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the stunned condition.
sections.Traits: Charge. If the rhinoceros moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Gore that turn, the hit deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage. A creature hit in this way must pass a DC 15 Strength save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away from the rhinoceros and fall prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gore attacks.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Quaking Stomp. The rhinoceros strikes the ground with its front feet. Every creature within 10 ft. of the rhinoceros must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or fall prone.

sections.Traits:

name: Seal

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The seal can hold its breath for 1 hour.
